component.name: OpenDisplay
component.summary: Use an iOS device as a Wayland display, or act as a display for another machine

description.p: OpenDisplay connects an existing, unmodified iOS/iPadOS receiver to a KDE or Hyprland Wayland session. It discovers receivers over the network or USB, captures the desktop with PipeWire, and streams H.264 produced by FFmpeg to the device.
It can also act as a receiver itself: listen for a sender (a Mac or another Linux machine), display the incoming H.264 stream live, and forward touch and scroll input back to the sender.
This package provides the graphical control application. The same engine also ships as a command-line client.
